description: Original task-centered lookup data. Matches are prompts for human interpretation, not an automatic style assignment.

contexts.title: SaaS product marketing
primary_tasks: Understand the product and the job it performs
Judge whether it fits the team's workflow
Try it, book a demo, or compare plans
decision_inputs: Who uses the product and who approves it?
Which workflow is hard to understand from a short explanation?
What can be shown honestly today?
content_to_show: A credible product screen or workflow
A concrete use case with real labels and states
Pricing, trial, demo, or integration details when known
interaction_states: Working product controls in the sample UI
Primary conversion action and its destination
Disclosure and error states for forms
visual_opportunities: Make one real product workflow the focal material
Use the interface's own information structure as the graphic language
Show context around a screen so it is legible
common_misses: A generic feature-card grid standing in for product evidence
Unverified customer logos, testimonials, or performance claims

contexts.title: Analytics and operations dashboard
primary_tasks: Notice what changed
Understand why the change matters
Choose the next investigation or action
decision_inputs: What decision is this view supporting?
What comparison and time range make the signal meaningful?
Which data is live, sampled, or illustrative?
content_to_show: One primary metric with units and comparison
A labeled chart or table with time context
Filters, data freshness, and an actionable anomaly when relevant
interaction_states: Loading, empty, stale, and error states
Drill-down or export path if the task needs it
visual_opportunities: Let a meaningful data pattern create the focal point
Use restrained status colors with a clear legend
Balance dense tables and summaries by decision importance
common_misses: A grid of unrelated KPI tiles
Charts with no units or readable labels
Color-only status and precision that the data cannot support

contexts.title: Finance and money tools
primary_tasks: Understand amount, timing, fees, and status
Compare options or assess exposure
Commit, cancel, or recover from an action
decision_inputs: What money or obligation is at stake?
Which fees, dates, and conditions change the decision?
Can the action be reversed?
content_to_show: Exact totals, currency, units, and dates
Fees, terms, and status labels near the relevant decision
A clear confirmation or recovery path
interaction_states: Pending, failed, reversed, and completed states
Input validation that explains the next step
visual_opportunities: Use aligned tabular figures and quiet hierarchy
Make risk and timing legible without alarmist color
Reserve emphasis for the decision and its consequence
common_misses: Urgency timers and ambiguous green/red meanings
Decorative charts detached from a user decision

contexts.title: Healthcare and care services
primary_tasks: Find a trustworthy service or answer
Complete a care-related task
Know what will happen and how private information is used
decision_inputs: Is this for urgent care, routine care, or general information?
What details are confirmed by the provider?
What accessibility or language needs matter?
content_to_show: Services, eligibility, location, access, and contact details
Plain-language next steps and expectations
Privacy and emergency guidance where relevant
interaction_states: Clear form errors and alternatives to digital contact
Accessible focus, labels, and status feedback
visual_opportunities: Create reassurance through clarity and wayfinding
Choose warmth or clinical precision from the real context
Make the next action visible without pressure
common_misses: Vague wellness language instead of service facts

contexts.title: Learning and study products
primary_tasks: Learn or recall a specific concept
Understand progress and gaps
Know what to practice next
decision_inputs: What is the learner trying to understand?
What does success mean for this session?
Which feedback helps learning rather than just engagement?
content_to_show: A real lesson, problem, passage, or practice item
Progress tied to meaningful learning outcomes
A clear next step and feedback explanation
interaction_states: Answer, reveal, retry, and completion states
Progress that remains understandable when interrupted
visual_opportunities: Treat the learning material as the main reading surface
Use progress as a quiet orientation cue
Make recall or annotation feel focused and tactile
common_misses: Streaks and badges that replace learning feedback
A timer competing with the lesson

contexts.title: Local business, food, and hospitality
primary_tasks: Decide whether to visit, book, or order
Check current practical details
Understand the place and what makes it worth choosing
decision_inputs: Where is it and when is it open?
What is available and at what price?
What real aspect of the place can anchor the design?
content_to_show: Location, hours, contact, access, and booking or ordering path
Menu or service details and prices when known
Real atmosphere, materials, people, or process
visual_opportunities: Use the actual place, product, or process as a visual anchor
Let a menu or schedule create typography and rhythm
Pair photography with precise logistical content
common_misses: Stock lifestyle photos that could describe any venue
Hidden prices or vague 'discover our story' filler

contexts.title: Product commerce and retail
primary_tasks: Inspect an item
Compare variants and fit
Understand delivery, returns, and care before buying
decision_inputs: What details reduce uncertainty about the item?
Which variants change price or availability?
What purchase information must be shown before checkout?
content_to_show: Product imagery at useful scale and angles
Price, variants, availability, delivery, returns, and care
Comparison details when multiple options exist
visual_opportunities: Give the object room and credible scale
Use swatches, specs, and packaging as part of the information design
Keep price and purchase conditions easy to scan
common_misses: Controls that look selectable but do nothing

contexts.title: Portfolio, creator, and agency work
primary_tasks: Assess the quality and relevance of the work
Understand the creator's role and point of view
Make contact or discuss a project
decision_inputs: Which projects best represent the work?
What role and context can be stated accurately?
What should a prospective client do next?
content_to_show: The work itself at a useful scale
Role, context, date, and outcome when known
Contact path and availability when relevant
visual_opportunities: Let the projects define page rhythm and color
Create an authored index or case-study composition
Use the creator's own artifacts as graphic material
common_misses: A hero that consumes more space than the work

contexts.title: Editorial, knowledge, and documentation
primary_tasks: Read and understand
Scan to find a specific answer
Navigate and return to useful material
decision_inputs: Is the user reading linearly or looking up a detail?
What figures, caveats, or sources need to stay adjacent?
How does navigation help orientation?
content_to_show: Title and author/context when useful
Clear heading structure, figures, and references
Wayfinding for long or interconnected material
interaction_states: Code, copy, search, or citation states where relevant
Readable behavior under zoom and text scaling
visual_opportunities: Use measure, annotations, captions, footnotes, and image cadence
Let typography support both reading and scanning
Create deliberate shifts between text and supporting material
common_misses: Callouts that interrupt the reading flow

contexts.title: Events and communities
primary_tasks: Decide whether the event is relevant
Understand when and where it happens
Register and prepare to attend
decision_inputs: What is confirmed about schedule and participants?
What access format and time zone apply?
What does attendance cost and require?
content_to_show: Date, time zone, venue or access link
Schedule, participants, cost, and registration status
Accessibility and practical attendance details
visual_opportunities: Use a real artifact, venue, or subject cue
Balance atmosphere with high-scan logistics
Let schedule structure create a distinctive composition
common_misses: A registration button with no event details

contexts.title: Utilities and creator tools
primary_tasks: Complete one focused task
Understand the result and its limits
Copy, export, or reuse the output
decision_inputs: What are the minimum inputs?
What constraints or assumptions affect the result?
What output format is useful next?
content_to_show: Inputs, defaults, and constraints
Live or submitted result with units/context
Copy, download, or share path when needed
interaction_states: Empty, invalid, processing, result, and failure
Keyboard operation and clear focus order
Confirmation for destructive reset or replacement
visual_opportunities: Make the input-output relationship the composition
Give the result enough prominence to be useful
Use progressive disclosure only for secondary options
common_misses: Marketing framing around a one-screen utility

contexts.title: Booking and marketplaces
primary_tasks: Find a suitable listing or time
Compare total cost and fit
Reserve and understand what happens next
decision_inputs: Which criteria define a suitable match?
What fees, location, and cancellation rules apply?
How trustworthy and current is availability?
content_to_show: Search criteria, relevant results, and comparison facts
Total price, fees, location, and availability
Provider/service details and cancellation terms
interaction_states: Search, filtered, no results, and loading
visual_opportunities: Make comparison easy without flattening all results into identical tiles
Keep total price and availability adjacent
Use maps or calendars when they directly answer the task
common_misses: A calendar that is difficult to scan or operate

contexts.title: Public information and civic services
primary_tasks: Find the correct service or policy
Understand eligibility and required steps
Complete the task without ambiguity
decision_inputs: Who is eligible and what evidence is needed?
What is the official source and update date?
Can a person complete this without digital-only access?
content_to_show: Eligibility, required documents, deadlines, and official contact
Step-by-step process and exceptions
Language, accessibility, and offline alternatives
interaction_states: Current service availability and maintenance notices
visual_opportunities: Use strong wayfinding and procedural hierarchy
Make state and requirements scannable
Design for varied literacy, language, and device conditions
common_misses: Unverified policy details or inaccessible PDF-only tasks

contexts.title: Developer tools and technical platforms
primary_tasks: Understand the integration or workflow
Get a working first result
Diagnose failures and choose a next action
decision_inputs: Which stack, environment, and permission model apply?
What is the shortest credible success path?
Which error is actionable and which is infrastructure context?
content_to_show: A real code or configuration example
Expected output and version/environment assumptions
Errors, logs, and recovery path
interaction_states: Copy feedback and code language context
Progress, failure, retry, and permission states
visual_opportunities: Use code, logs, topology, or a real interface as visual material
Treat density as an information hierarchy problem
Make a successful workflow legible without fake terminal decoration

contexts.title: Media and entertainment
primary_tasks: Discover or resume meaningful content
Understand media details and access
Control playback or participation
decision_inputs: Is the main task discovery, playback, collection, or purchase?
What content art is licensed and available?
Which controls must remain reachable?
content_to_show: Real or clearly labeled sample content
Useful metadata and availability
Progress, saved state, and controls relevant to the task
interaction_states: Play, pause, seek, loading, and unavailable
visual_opportunities: Let the content's own visual language shape the interface
Use motion only to reinforce state or atmosphere
Build discovery rhythm from real metadata and artwork
common_misses: Generic dark mode with neon accents
Decorative media cards with no real interaction
Autoplay or motion that takes control from the user
